'''BX77:8181636.1872''' was a [[New Republic Intelligence Service|New Republic Intelligence]] [[Datafile/Legends|datafile]] that cataloged the specific vessels and [[Starship/Legends|starship]] classes that were used during the [[Corellian Crisis|Starbuster Plot]] by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], [[Human League]] and other parties. It was appended to datafile [[9912.78.3]].
